results.corrected_title: Alibaba makes Qwen4-Max generally available via QwenCloud
results.corrected_summary: Alibaba announced on 16 November 2026 that Qwen4-Max is generally available through QwenCloud, after a limited preview that began 11 November. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with about 2.4 trillion total parameters (71B active per token), native image input and a 1M-token context window. Alibaba says it uses 35% fewer tokens than Qwen3.8-Max on its Work360 benchmark at High effort. Smaller Qwen4 models are planned as open-weight releases, with no date given.
key_facts: GA via QwenCloud announced 2026-11-16; limited preview from 2026-11-11
35% fewer tokens than Qwen3.8-Max on Alibaba's Work360 benchmark at High effort (vendor claim)
Average task cost fell about 58-60% per Alibaba/TechNode
Smaller Qwen4 models to be open-weight later, no date
results.issues: Sources do not say the model is closed/API-only; do not claim that.

results.corrected_summary: Alphabet-backed Isomorphic Labs announced a $5 billion Series C on 17 November 2026, co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital. Andreessen Horowitz joined as a new investor; returning investors include Thrive Capital, GV and CapitalG. The round came about six months after its $2.1B Series B in May 2026, and no valuation was disclosed.
key_facts: Co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital
Previous round was a $2.1B Series B in May 2026

results.corrected_title: Oregon sues OpenAI for at least $2.035 billion over ChatGPT child safety
results.corrected_summary: Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield announced a lawsuit against OpenAI on 17 November 2026 in Multnomah County Circuit Court, seeking at least $2.035 billion. The claims are violations of the Unlawful Trade Practices Act over alleged misleading statements about ChatGPT's safety for minors, negligence, unjust enrichment and public nuisance. These are unproven allegations. OpenAI points to its existing safety measures.
key_facts: Filed in Multnomah County Circuit Court
Claims: unlawful trade practices, negligence, unjust enrichment, public nuisance

results.corrected_summary: At Ignite 2026 on 17 November, Microsoft announced Agent 365 updates. Connected agents from third-party platforms sync into the Agent 365 registry and receive an Entra Agent ID, with support rolling out to platforms including Salesforce Agentforce, Amazon AgentCore, Google Vertex AI, Databricks and Snowflake, completing in December. Local agents such as GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code get their own Entra Agent ID in preview.
key_facts: Connected agents receive an Entra Agent ID; rollout completes in December
Local agents like GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code get Entra Agent ID (preview)
Local agent discovery in Defender is generally available
